backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a diary application backend with Internet Identity authorization, journal entries, daily summaries, user profiles, photo storage via blob storage, calendar preferences, and insights data including mood tracking and activity analysis.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a logo replacement task (dayry-logo.dim_512x512.png with image-9.png) with high confidence, listing affected components and test ID REQ-1.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend source files covering authentication, diary editing, history views, AI generation, mood analysis, React Query hooks, styling, PIN security, and contextual data simulation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light and dark themes, including background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the DAYRY app with favicon reference to dayry-logo.dim_512x512.png and script loading main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Documentation describing DAYRY as an AI-powered diary app built on Internet Computer with Internet Identity authentication, IC canister storage, React 19 frontend, and features including AI prompts, mood detection, photo attachments, and insights dashboard.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component managing Internet Identity authentication flow, routing between sign-in/sign-up screens, profile setup for new users, and authenticated diary interface with write/history/insights views.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGridLay: Empty file, likely a placeholder for future grid-based authentication layout component.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthScreenL: Reusable layout wrapper for authentication screens featuring centered card with icon, title, description, and gradient styling.
frontend/src/components/auth/CurrentUnau: Empty file, likely a placeholder for the current version of unauthenticated home page content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LegacyUnaut: Marketing landing page for unauthenticated users showcasing DAYRY features with hero section, feature cards, and login button.
frontend/src/components/auth/LogInScreen: Empty file, likely a placeholder for login screen component.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: First-time user onboarding form that collects the user's name and saves it to their profile after authentication.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Sign-in screen component displaying the DAYRY logo, tagline, feature cards (AI-powered writing, mood insights, privacy, calendar, photo memories), and authentication buttons with loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignUpScree: Sign-up screen component showing DAYRY branding, benefits checklist (unlimited entries, mood tracking, blockchain storage, photos/recaps), and feature cards to encourage new user registration.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Deprecated authentication guard component marked for backwards compatibility; authentication logic has been moved to App.tsx.
frontend/src/components/CalendarView.tsx: Calendar component with monthly and weekly view modes, navigation controls, date selection, and visual indicators for journal entries with mood badges.
frontend/src/components/ContextEditor.ts: Dialog component for editing contextual data (location, time of day, activity, screen usage) with dropdowns and inputs, triggering AI regeneration of diary text on save.
frontend/src/components/DiaryEditor.tsx: Main diary writing interface with AI text generation (starter and contextual), mood detection, photo attachment support, and context editing capabilities.
frontend/src/components/DiaryHistory.tsx: Tabbed interface for browsing diary entries, calendar view, summaries, and photos with filtering and search functionality (currently shows placeholder alerts for empty state).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright and attribution link to caffeine.ai with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header with view switching (Write/History/Insights), theme toggle, settings dialog (UI scale, PIN settings), and logout functionality for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/InsightsDashboar: Dashboard displaying mood patterns and writing statistics with placeholder cards for total entries, positive entries, activities tracked, and best writing time (empty state).
frontend/src/components/MoodIndicator.ts: Badge component displaying mood state (positive/neutral/negative) with corresponding icon (Smile/Meh/Frown) and color styling in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/components/PinSettings.tsx: Provides a settings UI for managing PIN security, allowing users to set, change, or remove a 4-digit PIN with multi-step verification dialogs.
frontend/src/components/PinSetup.tsx: Onboarding component for setting up a new 4-digit PIN with confirmation step, includes skip option for optional setup.
PIN entry screen with attempt limiting (max 5) that verifies user PIN before granting access to the diary.
frontend/src/components/RecapGeneratorDi: Dialog component that generates a visual recap image by compositing selected photos and entry statistics onto a canvas with gradient background.
frontend/src/components/UiScaleSetting.t: Settings component with a dropdown selector for adjusting UI scale/size for accessibility and readability.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the backend actor with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options for idle behavior and derivation origin.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including user profiles, journal entries, daily summaries, photos, weekly recaps, calendar preferences, insights, and entry statistics with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUiScale.ts: React hook for managing UI scale preferences (100%-150%) stored in localStorage, applying scale to root font-size and CSS custom property for responsive text sizing.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers, defining light/dark theme color variables in OKLCH format (purple/blue diary theme), custom scrollbar styling, and base styles with UI scale support.
frontend/src/lib/aiGenerator.ts: Generates contextual diary entry starters and templates based on time of day, location, activity, and screen usage data. Provides varied natural-sounding prompts with optional inclusion of different contextual elements.
frontend/src/lib/contextualData.ts: Simulates contextual data (location, time of day, activity type, screen usage) based on current time and day patterns. Maps locations and times to realistic activities for diary entry generation.
frontend/src/lib/moodAnalyzer.ts: Analyzes text sentiment by counting positive and negative keywords, handling negations, and classifying mood as positive, neutral, or negative based on keyword scores.
frontend/src/lib/pinSecurity.ts: Provides PIN-based security with hashing, verification, and simple XOR encryption/decryption for diary content using localStorage for PIN storage.
frontend/src/lib/storage.ts: Legacy localStorage utilities for diary entries marked as deprecated; all functions now redirect to Internet Computer backend via React Query hooks for authoritative data storage.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended border radius, shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file for DAYRY application tracking one completed feature to replace a logo image. Contains project metadata, schema version 1.0.0, and configuration for instant clarification mode.
